ValidationRule.description:
Contains MD also. Cloning but deactivating to keep the MD values.
Validation rule to restrict editing of the CTX Attorney fields that are updated through the Update_Attorneys ADF pipeline.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( OR( $Profile.Name = "API Only User", $Profile.Name = "API Only", $User.Alias = "apionly" ) ), NOT( AND( ISBLANK(MD_User_ID__c), ISBLANK(Cashtrax_Id__c) ) ), OR( AND( $RecordType.Name = "Attorney", Contact_Source_Description__c = "CashTrax User" ), $RecordType.Name = "Move_Docs_User" ), OR( ISCHANGED(AccountId), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName__c), ISCHANGED(NickName__c), ISCHANGED(Phone), ISCHANGED(BarVerificationDate__c), ISCHANGED(BarVerificationExpirationDate__c), ISCHANGED(Fax), ISCHANGED(Email), ISCHANGED(Phone_Extension__c), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ISCHANGED(Attorney_ID__c), ISCHANGED(Title), ISCHANGED(LastDateFunded__c), ISCHANGED(DateFundedPlus7days__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only API Only Users are permitted to edit these fields on CashTrax Attorney records.
